annotations.title: Change an app's colours and fonts

description: Rewrites an app's colours and fonts in its files (the theme tokens in main.css, the Google Fonts link in index.html) and stores the theme. Tokens the developer deleted stay out, listed in `missing`. Waits for neblla_promote "save". neblla_update_app `theme` only stores it. More: neblla_get_llms tools/retheme_app

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

palette.description: Hex colours, e.g. { background: "#14131C", primary: "#6C8CFF", dark: true }.

typography.description: The pair of fonts for titles and body.

name: neblla_retheme_app
title: Change an app's colours and fonts
